thread:
Aria: Heads up — kv-pool-x saw a steady memory increase during the midnight canary run, culminating in OOM at ~00:42 UTC. grafana: https://metrics.internal/redwood/kv/pool-x/allocs. Heap snapshot uploaded: s3://redwood-infer/dumps/3225000000-kvpoolx-heap.gz
Ravi: Oncall here. Pausing canary traffic and scaling down prefetch parallelism to 25%. Can someone claim triage?
Kim: I'll take the deep-dive. Quick look at the pprof shows a lot of retained bytes in slab buckets 64k-256k and many refs originating from prefetch.cancellation goroutines. I suspect freelist misuse + missed release in fast path.
Lena: Ops will prepare a temporary guard: set `KV_MAX_RESIDENCY=110MB` and add an ingress circuit to divert canary traffic if residency climbs >80% of that for 5m. Scheduling a rolling restart to apply.
Aria: Added the heap link above and a short `pprof top` extract: top shows alloc_map.reserve -> kv_prefetch.go:210 and async_worker.go:89 as heavy.
Kim: Plan: (1) run slab-scan that maps freelist span sizes + top stacks (2) enable soft-eviction and monitor (3) instrument refcount increments on prefetched objects. ETA: 48h for initial report. Assigning Kim.
Ravi: I'll own monitoring/alerts and correlate with prior incidents to see if this is a recurrence pattern. Reminder: last quarter we saw similar drift but with different stack signatures; see internal note INF-0987.
Ops-Bot: Ticket INF-1234 created — "kv-pool-x emergency guard + slab-scan" assigned to Lena, due 2026-03-29. https://jira.internal/INF-1234
deploy-bot: Canary rolled back to stable rev 789; health checks passing. Will watch for 1h. :white_check_mark:
Lena: Ops will run nightly slab-scan for 2 nights and post summaries here. Adding one-off job to capture vmstat + freelist dump at 30s intervals during repro runs.
Kim: Hypothesis: a race where cancellation path bypasses decrement in reserve fast path, leaving sticky references in freelist. Will create a small repro and attach to the report. Also will grep for recent changes to kv_prefetch.go and freelist helpers.
Aria: Quick mitigation checklist: - apply KV_MAX_RESIDENCY env on canaries (Lena, today) - enable soft-eviction (Ravi, now) - run nightly slab-scan for 2 days (Lena, nightly) - deep profile + repro (Kim, 48h) - monitoring rule: page on >95% guard for 5m (Ravi, now)
Ravi: Implemented alert policy and muted noisy pages for this shard. I'll keep owning interim oncall until we ship a fix.
Kim: Found a suspicious commit range: PR#845 modified freelist fast path; will include diff and a proposed patch to ensure release happens on cancellation. Adding unit test to repro retention.
Lena: Ops note: emergency flip commands will be in INF-1234 runbook. Example command to flip guard: `kubectl set env deploy/kv-canary KV_MAX_RESIDENCY=110MB --namespace=prod-canary` and to enable circuit: `curl -X POST https://ingress.internal/circuit -d '{"pool":"kv-pool-x","threshold":0.8}'`
Aria: Let's sync in 48h at 10:00 to review Kim's profiling report and choose PR vs mitigations. If anything spikes before then, reopen thread.
Ravi: Marking action owners on the ticket. I'll also run a quick grep across other pools to detect similar prefetch stacks to catch a wider regression.
Kim: Uploading profiler bundle to s3: s3://redwood-infer/profiles/3225000000-kim-kvpoolx-prof.tar.gz. Will post the slab-scan digest by EOD tomorrow.
Lena: Nightly restart scheduled at 01:15 UTC. Ops-Bot will post status updates here.
Ops-Bot: Rolling restarts started for kv-canary nodes. Progress: 2/5 done.
Aria: Thanks all. Short updates only in this thread. I'll draft a follow-up postmortem stub after the sync with consolidated action items and timelines.
